newsitem.title: USA: Enron to merge with Enron Global.
newsitem.headline: Enron to merge with Enron Global.

text.p: Enron Corp said Monday it will merge with Enron Global Power & Pipelines LLC, making Enron Global a wholly-owned subsidiary.
The company said Enron Power shareholders will receive $35 per share in its common stock.
The merger is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1997 and is subject to the approval of a majority of Enron Global shareholders other than Enron, it said.
Enron said the price is a 25 percent premium over the $28 per share trading price for Enron Global shares one month prior to the merger proposal.
Enron Global has about 26 million shares outstanding with 12.5 million in the open market and 13.5 million owned by Enron, the company said.
